name: JoAi: Query Metrics

description.en: Read normalized metrics for an explicit source, resource, and period. Providers: Cloudflare (web traffic), Google Search Console (search clicks/impressions), and Instagram (reach, views, profile views, followers; max 30 days).
description.de: Lies normalisierte Metriken für eine explizite Quelle, Ressource und einen Zeitraum. Provider: Cloudflare (Webtraffic), Google Search Console (Suchklicks/Impressionen) und Instagram (Reichweite, Aufrufe, Profilaufrufe, Follower; max. 30 Tage).
description.es: Consulta métricas normalizadas para una fuente, un recurso y un período explícitos. Proveedores: Cloudflare (tráfico web), Google Search Console (clics/impresiones de búsqueda) e Instagram (alcance, vistas, visitas al perfil, seguidores; máx. 30 días).
description.fr: Consulte des métriques normalisées pour une source, une ressource et une période explicites. Fournisseurs : Cloudflare (trafic web), Google Search Console (clics/impressions de recherche) et Instagram (portée, vues, vues du profil, abonnés ; max. 30 jours).
description.ro: Citește metrici normalizate pentru o sursă, o resursă și o perioadă explicite. Furnizori: Cloudflare (trafic web), Google Search Console (clicuri/impresii de căutare) și Instagram (reach, vizualizări, vizualizări profil, urmăritori; max. 30 zile).
description.it: Leggi metriche normalizzate per una fonte, una risorsa e un periodo espliciti. Provider: Cloudflare (traffico web), Google Search Console (clic/impressioni di ricerca) e Instagram (reach, visualizzazioni, visualizzazioni profilo, follower; max 30 giorni).

bot: Use this to obtain source-backed facts before creating a client update. For analytics, report web.uniqueVisitors and web.pageViews exactly as returned. For Cloudflare, report unique visitors and page views exactly as returned. For google_search_console, report search.clicks and search.impressions — these are Search Console metrics, not site analytics visitors. For instagram, report social.reach, social.views, social.profileViews, and social.followers (periods up to 30 days). Analytics resource is the site key from the Site record; Cloudflare resource is the 32-char zone tag; Google Search Console uses sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/; Instagram uses the numeric account id (INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID).

description.en: Provider resource id. Analytics: site key from the Site record. Cloudflare: 32-char zone tag. Google Search Console: sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Instagram: numeric account id.
description.de: Ressourcenkennung. Analytics: Site-Key aus dem Website-Eintrag. Cloudflare: 32-stelliger Zone-Tag. Google Search Console: sc-domain:example.com oder https://example.com/. Instagram: numerische Account-ID.
